sections_en.text: The first draft of this document was prepared by Eng. Ali Hussein Farrag. The field test was carried out by Eng. Ali Hussein Farrag and Eng. Osama Fathy Abdel Karim. It was approved by Eng. Abdel Nasser Maarouf Ahmed, Technical Consultant for Electrical Maintenance, and endorsed by Eng. Ibrahim El-Shahat Ibrahim, Sector Head, and documented by Eng. Gamal Abdel Wahab, Head of the Quality Sector and MPIS Coordinator at the Upper Egypt Electricity Production Company.
Isolate all switches connected to the busbars to be tested.
Follow the occupational safety and health instructions for the safety of personnel and equipment.

items: AC V-A voltage measuring instrument, model Yokogawa

rows: Set the change-over switch (43) type BH-H7 for testing protection (a27G) to the Test position on the protection cell.
Remove the outer cover on the relay and clean the relay with an air blower, cleaning the two relay connection plugs to the voltage transformer.
Insert Test plug type HP2-P4 into Test socket type HR2A-P4 for relay (a27G) on the protection cell.
Set the Normal-Test switch on the relay to Test for phase R, to test R.
Inject voltage at points (21, 24) on the Test Plug.
Raise the voltage to a value above the setting value, 45 V.
Reduce the voltage until the indication appears on the relay.
Switch off the voltage injection test set.
Return the Normal-Test switch on the relay for phase R to the Normal position.
Set the Normal-Test switch on the relay to Test for phase S, to test S.
Inject voltage at points (22, 24) on the Test Plug.
Raise the voltage to a value above the setting value, 45 V.
Reduce the voltage until the indication appears on the relay.
Switch off the voltage injection test set.
Return the Normal-Test switch on the relay for phase S to the Normal position.
Set the Normal-Test switch on the relay to Test for phase T, to test T.
Inject voltage at points (23, 24) on the Test plug.
Raise the voltage to a value above the setting value (45 V).
Reduce the voltage until the indication appears on the relay.
Switch off the voltage injection test set.
Return the Normal-Test switch on the relay for phase T to the Normal position.
Fit the glass cover on the relay.
Remove Test Plug type HP2-P4 from the Test Socket of the protection cell.
Set the change-over switch (43) type BH-H7 for testing protection (a27G) to the Normal position on the protection cell.

Egyptian Electricity Holding Company
Maintenance Procedures Information System
Maintenance Procedures Information System
 | Protection - Generation | Maintenance Procedures
Document No.: UVR-013-r0a | Equipment: Undervoltage protection on the 220 kV busbars S27G TVU3F--BG21 TOSHIBA
Issued to: El-Walidia Power Station
Status: Approved
Approval date: 15 January 2007 | Procedure: Using the SVERKER 650 test set
Next review date: January 2012
Introduction
The first draft of this document was prepared by Eng. Ali Hussein Farrag. The field test was carried out by Eng. Ali Hussein Farrag and Eng. Osama Fathy Abdel Karim. It was approved by Eng. Abdel Nasser Maarouf Ahmed, Technical Consultant for Electrical Maintenance, and endorsed by Eng. Ibrahim El-Shahat Ibrahim, Sector Head, and documented by Eng. Gamal Abdel Wahab, Head of the Quality Sector and MPIS Coordinator at the Upper Egypt Electricity Production Company.
Safety Precautions
Isolate all switches connected to the busbars to be tested.
Open the work order.
Fence off the work area.
Place the necessary warning signs.
Follow the occupational safety and health instructions for the safety of personnel and equipment.
Tools, Instruments and Equipment Used
Sverker 650 test set
AC V-A voltage measuring instrument, model Yokogawa
Test plug, model HP2-P4
Test leads
Procedures to be Carried Out
Set the change-over switch (43) type BH-H7 for testing protection (a27G) to the Test position on the protection cell. | 1.
Remove the outer cover on the relay and clean the relay with an air blower, cleaning the two relay connection plugs to the voltage transformer. | 2.
Insert Test plug type HP2-P4 into Test socket type HR2A-P4 for relay (a27G) on the protection cell. | 3.
Set the Normal-Test switch on the relay to Test for phase R, to test R. | 4.
Inject voltage at points (21, 24) on the Test Plug. | 5.
Raise the voltage to a value above the setting value, 45 V. | 6.
Reduce the voltage until the indication appears on the relay. | 7.
Record the voltage value (Operating Value). | 8.
Switch off the voltage injection test set. | 9.
Return the Normal-Test switch on the relay for phase R to the Normal position. | 10.
Set the Normal-Test switch on the relay to Test for phase S, to test S. | 11.
Inject voltage at points (22, 24) on the Test Plug. | 12.
Raise the voltage to a value above the setting value, 45 V. | 13.
Reduce the voltage until the indication appears on the relay. | 14.
Record the voltage value (Operating Value). | 15.
Switch off the voltage injection test set. | 16.
Return the Normal-Test switch on the relay for phase S to the Normal position. | 17.
Set the Normal-Test switch on the relay to Test for phase T, to test T. | 18.
Inject voltage at points (23, 24) on the Test plug. | 19.
Raise the voltage to a value above the setting value (45 V). | 20.
Reduce the voltage until the indication appears on the relay. | 21.
Record the voltage value (Operating Value). | 22.
Switch off the voltage injection test set. | 23.
Return the Normal-Test switch on the relay for phase T to the Normal position. | 24.
Fit the glass cover on the relay. | 25.
Remove Test Plug type HP2-P4 from the Test Socket of the protection cell. | 26.
Set the change-over switch (43) type BH-H7 for testing protection (a27G) to the Normal position on the protection cell. | 27.
